hints.title: Compare Remaining Suffixes
hints.text: When choosing between the front of word1 and word2, compare the entire remaining suffixes lexicographically.

hints.title: Greedy Suffix Selection
hints.text: If suffix of word1 is greater than or equal to suffix of word2, take the leading character of word1; otherwise take from word2.

hints.title: Append Remaining Characters
hints.text: Continue until one string is exhausted, then append the entire remainder of the other string.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing entire suffixes at each step takes up to O(n + m) time, giving O((n + m)^2) in the worst case which easily passes for lengths <= 3000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy suffix comparison avoids exponential branching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains why lexicographical suffix comparison resolves ties optimally.
